name: alpine_musl_wheel
description: Works on a glibc-based dev machine but the CI runner uses an Alpine (musl) image. Many compiled wheels are glibc-only (manylinux), so the package fails to import on musl. A libc drift that lockfiles do not capture.
traceback: ImportError: Error loading shared library libc.musl-x86_64.so.1: No such file or directory (needed by _psycopg.so)
